{{Quote|I look at you and see neurons fire in your brain. I scan your body and know how you taste.|[[SCORPIO]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Neurons''' were sensory cells in many organisms, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="DV3D">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader: A 3-D Reconstruction Log]]''</ref> and [[Bith/Legends|Bith]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> They sent information as signals to the [[Brain/Legends|brain]], where they usually had their highest concentration, and back to other parts of the body, controlling motor and sensory functions.

After breaking the neck of [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] saw microscopically through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as the neurons in his master stopped firing and his [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] died out.<ref name="DP" />

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was equipped with a [[sensor web]] that attached to his neural system in order to power the prosthetics that he acquired after the [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|Duel on Mustafar]]. If his neurons failed to send signals to his limbs, he would be rendered immobile and a programmed alert would be automatically sent to the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] by [[Hyperwave/Legends|hyperwave]] signal.<ref name="DV3D" />

When [[Tobb Jadak]] was in his decades-long coma following a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] collision, his neurons were stimulated at the by [[Chief Neurologist]] [[Lial Sompa]] at the [[Aurora Medical Facility]]. The last time Sompa performed this operation on Jadak was weeks before his awakening in [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
